Comment: CloudLab c240g5: as experiment.wiki-c1024-cloudlab-gpu-4to8-copy-then-flip.json, but with its stream behind the queries: every node runs with --own-reads-first, so an old node serves the stream's reads (RAW_GET) only when its own queries leave room on the device, a few at a time (fusion/read_budget.h). A baseline, the other end of copy-then-flip's trade-off from the stream-first files: the queries keep the 4 nodes' capacity, and the flip waits until the load lets the stream through -- where the load stays above C4, until it ends and the backlog has drained.
